question: When and where were the flight trials of the ULPGM‑V3 missile conducted?
solution: The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh (Kurnool), 25 July 2025**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The flight trials of the **ULPGM‑V3 missile** were conducted in **Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh** on **25 July 2025**, showcasing advancements in missile technology. • The **ULPGM‑V3 missile** is a next-generation, precision-guided munition developed to enhance **defense capabilities** and improve **target accuracy**. • This trial was part of a larger effort by the **Indian defense sector** to modernize and test new technologies under challenging conditions to ensure operational reliability. • Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, has been a preferred location for defense trials due to its suitable **terrain and controlled environment**, which are critical for testing advanced weaponry. • This successful flight trial marked a significant milestone in strengthening India's defense systems and achieving **self-reliance** in advanced missile technology.
